dct_description_sm: Click Here for Metadata. This dataset contains trail features and issues from 2013 such as infrastructure issues within or adjacent to the Conservation Areas (bike jumps, unauthorized use, ruts, and other trail issues) as well as access trails -places where the public access the Conservation Areas or rock climbing access points.  The dataset is not exhaustive and does not represent all trails in Conservation Halton's watershed. A GPS data survey was completed for, but limited to the following areas; Hilton Falls, Glenorchy, Rattlesnake Point, Crawford Lake and Mount Nemo Conservation Areas. In addition, some data was also collected from the bluffs Resource Management Area and Environmentally Sensitive Areas 8 (Mount Nemo Escarpment Woods and Extension), 16 (Sixteen mile Creek Valley and Extension), 18 (Crawford Lake - Rattlesnake Point Escarpment Woods). The data is considered accurate to +/-5m or better. Other portions of this dataset outside the areas listed above, represent portions of the Bruce Trail or "Other" trails, see the Trail Type attribute for clarification.
